groups.title: build(bsx): add pinned native module and LND lease bridge
groups.description: Integrate the pinned native swap module, the LND lease-output API and native build requirements. Preserve vendor build metadata and development artifacts here for exact reconstruction; cleanup follows separately.

groups.title: feat(bsx): add configuration and deterministic wallet identity
groups.description: Define swap contracts, network configuration, migrations and deterministic main-key derivation, with their existing tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): add swap state and independent rate calculations
groups.description: Add transient swap state, persisted addresses, rate services and amount conversion. Keep the vendor persistence exclusions and rate/amount tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): constrain swap funding and signing to confirmed inputs
groups.description: Add coin selection and reservation, durable signing records, RPC deadlines and PSBT spending checks. Includes the final vendor safeguards and their regression tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): manage swap engine lifecycle and recovery
groups.description: Integrate the native API, lease reconciliation, startup/restart, background wakes, notifications and lifecycle state descriptions.

groups.title: feat(bsx): add shared swap controls and presentation
groups.description: Add reusable swap controls, status displays, branding and styling, with the shared header extension and component tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): create and confirm swap requests
groups.description: Add amount entry, independent fee/offer estimates, validation and request confirmation with the existing screen tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): accept offers and manage external wallet pay-ins
groups.description: Add request lists/details, offer checks, external-wallet deposits, partial payments and refund presentation with the existing tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): display active swaps and completed receipts
groups.description: Add swap lists, progress, transaction events and completed receipts, preserving the existing detail-screen tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): configure swap servers and connection trust
groups.description: Add settings drafts, bridge trust, Electrum servers, rate services and restart handling with their existing tests.

groups.title: feat(bsx): manage addresses and export swap diagnostics
groups.description: Add address management, native diagnostic controls and user-initiated log export.

groups.title: feat(bsx): connect swaps to the Nexus wallet interface
groups.description: Activate swap navigation, startup recovery, notification routing, scanning, wallet entry and history previews. Preserve remaining vendor integration changes for the exact-tree checkpoint.

mapping_method: Each original commit is indexed by the final file groups it touched. This is a review index, not a patch replay recipe. Exact preservation is established by identical Git trees. Historical-only paths have no surviving diff against the base.

cleanup_commits.subject: chore(bsx): remove vendor release and development artifacts
test(bsx): make the swap validation suite reproducible
refactor(bsx): remove unused swap row offset scaffolding
build(bsx): record iOS dependencies and local source installation
